description: This is a PHP class named 'Type' that extends 'BaseOption', found within the namespace 'Api\V8\Param\Options'. It defines a method 'add' which configures a Symfony OptionsResolver to require a 'type' parameter, enforce its type as string, and validate its value using a custom closure involving validation constraints.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: A class that extends 'BaseOption' and configures validation rules for a 'type' parameter in API options.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Configures the OptionsResolver to require a 'type' parameter of type string and validates its value against specific constraints, including a regex pattern that disallows certain module names.
